recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有數個巨核細胞，細胞核深染、形狀不規則或碎裂成多團，細胞質相對減少，旁邊還有深染、濃縮的核碎片，背景散在造血細胞與脂肪空泡，符合化療後巨核細胞的受損變化（chemotherapy effect）。
features: Several megakaryocytes clustered near fat spaces in a spicule-edge area
Nuclei are hyperchromatic, irregularly lobulated or separated into discrete fragments
Cytoplasm is reduced in some cells, with a naked or near-naked nuclear appearance
Background of mixed maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors with prominent fat vacuoles
Thick, dark-staining crenated red cells indicate a drying/thick-smear artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle edge with interspersed fat vacuoles and mixed hematopoietic precursors. Several megakaryocytes show hyperchromatic, irregular and fragmented nuclear lobes with reduced cytoplasm, a pattern of degenerative change. Interpretation is partly limited by thick areas with dark-staining red cells. In the appropriate clinical context, findings are consistent with cytotoxic chemotherapy effect on megakaryocytes.

ddx.vs: MDS megakaryocytes show separated round nuclear lobes or hypolobation with preserved cytoplasm rather than degenerative condensed, fragmented nuclei, and require no recent therapy history.
Emperipolesis shows intact hematopoietic cells within megakaryocyte cytoplasm, whereas the nuclear fragmentation here is intrinsic to the megakaryocyte.
Megaloblastic megakaryocytes are hypersegmented but accompanied by megaloblastic erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes.
